foundation.title: Financial assistance application
foundation.description: Phase 1 is ready: the Next.js App Router foundation, TypeScript, Tailwind styling, localization, and English/Arabic route structure are in place.
foundation.phaseDescription: The form wizard, validation, local draft persistence, mock submission, and AI assistance will be integrated in later phases.

landing.title: Apply for support with a clear guided form.
landing.description: Start a secure application, move through each section at your pace, and return later with your progress saved on this device.

fast.title: Step-by-step
fast.description: The application is organized into personal, family, financial, and situation sections.

secure.title: Private by design
secure.description: Your draft is stored locally in your browser and cleared after a successful mock submission.

guided.title: Ready for smart help
guided.description: The form structure is prepared for AI writing assistance in the situation section.

form.title: Financial assistance application
form.description: Complete the application in three guided sections. Your progress is saved automatically on this device as you move through the form.

helpers.nationalId: Use letters, numbers, or hyphens only.
helpers.dependents: Enter the number of people financially dependent on you.
helpers.monthlyIncome: Enter your estimated monthly income before assistance.
helpers.financialSituation: Describe income, expenses, debts, and urgent financial needs.
helpers.employmentCircumstances: Describe your work status and any recent changes.
helpers.reasonForApplying: Explain what support you need and how it would help.

submit.successDescription: Reference {applicationId} was submitted on {submittedAt}. Your local draft has been cleared.
submit.failure: We could not submit the application right now. Please try again.
submit.invalid: Please fix the highlighted fields before submitting.
